purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kamukunji Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This constituency's Form 34B also carries a second, independent 'Aggregate Results' + 'Voter Turn Out' summary table on the form's final signature page (page 4 of 4), which was cross-read and found to reproduce the identical registered-voter, candidate-vote and turnout figures as the page-3 TOTAL row used for materialization.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. The same session first discovered a genuine IEBC-side download-cache mismatch on a neighboring constituency id (277917, requested for Starehe, repeatedly served CON 029 content instead) and discarded that row rather than promote it; this Kamukunji row was independently re-confirmed against its own printed CON 288 header, and cross-checked against a second in-form summary table, before being recorded.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row, cross-checked against the form's separate 'Aggregate Results' summary table on page 4 of 4 (identical candidate figures: 35,552 / 25,830 / 99 / 253) and the 'Voter Turn Out' summary block (registered 128,516; turned out 63,126; turnout 49.12%), which independently reconciles to the same total ballots cast (61,734 valid + 1,392 rejected = 63,126).

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
